checks: The European Commission describes the EU requirement to use a seat belt in any seat fitted with one. Rules also cover child restraints.
EU core jurisdictions, road transport and fitted seats
Check vehicle classes, child height limits, exceptions, local enforcement, and separate local traffic rules.
Eligible European Health Insurance Card holders can access medically necessary state-provided care during temporary stays under the relevant arrangements and local terms.
EHIC scope for eligible holders in covered territories; core jurisdictions
European Commission, Employment, Social Affairs and Inclusion
This is healthcare entitlement, not a border requirement. Verify nationality and insurance eligibility, local charges and separate travel and repatriation coverage.
The Commission describes covered terrestrial mobile roaming under eligible home plans across the EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Moldova and Ukraine. Fair-use limits may apply.
Eligible contracts in participating European jurisdictions; terrestrial roaming
Check plan eligibility, local networks and inadvertent cross-border connections. Satellite networks on ships or aircraft are outside the regime. SIM registration and radio restrictions are separate.
Home Office guidance records legally distinct Crown Dependency ETA schemes from April 2026 and recognition arrangements between the UK and Crown Dependencies.
Guernsey and Isle of Man immigration, with route and status exceptions
Verify the destination's own scheme, purpose, nationality, existing permission and Common Travel Area route.
The dedicated customs page says cash of GBP 10,000 or equivalent or more must be declared on entry or exit. Other government pages use the phrase above GBP 10,000.
Isle of Man cash reporting; inbound and outbound
Isle of Man Government, Customs and Excise
Check the exact boundary against the current legal text and official form. Do not treat equality as exempt based solely on the overview.
An arrival overview uses above GBP 10,000 language and says routes from the UK and Ireland can trigger reporting.
Isle of Man arrivals from outside the island
Isle of Man Government, Customs and Excise
Exact-boundary language differs from the dedicated declaration page.
Most dogs, cats and ferrets can move between Great Britain and the Isle of Man without animal-health documentation under the listed rules.
Great Britain to/from the Isle of Man; specified pets and routes
Check restricted breeds, other origins, carrier rules, and the current requirements if also traveling to the EU.
Government motoring guidance says non-resident visitors may drive for up to 12 months using their current full driving licence.
Isle of Man Government, Drivers and Vehicles
Confirm licence class, residence, endorsements and insurance. Rental terms and local rules are separate.
The civil aviation authority lists a distinct local Small Unmanned Aircraft Order and remotely piloted aircraft guidance.
Isle of Man civil aviation law
Isle of Man Civil Aviation Administration
Check operational category, current amendments, airport controls and permissions. Do not inherit UK or EU rules.
From 15 July 2026, Gibraltar's technical notice describes a new process for travelers requiring a Schengen short-stay visa. The prior UK visa application process for Gibraltar closed on 8 July 2026.
Gibraltar under provisional UK–EU treaty arrangements; covered short-stay travelers
Verify passport-specific status, transitional nationalities, route, movement within Schengen and local long stays. Do not infer uniform Schengen membership or clearance.
The July government statement confirms that travelers still need the relevant entry permission and that arrivals needing a visa can be refused without it.
Gibraltar immigration and routes involving Spain
Check the current border procedure, passport and application route before publication.
Gibraltar Customs describes conditions for temporary duty-free use of a visitor's car and calls for current driving licences and vehicle registration documents.
Gibraltar temporary import of a non-resident visitor's private vehicle
Check whether the guidance has been updated for treaty implementation, plus insurance and rental-vehicle conditions.
Gibraltar civil aviation guidance identifies scenarios requiring specific permission, including certain flights near the airport, in congested areas or near people and property.
Confirm the current operating policy and permits for the exact site, weight and purpose. Drone import remains open.
Singapore's consumption regulations specify a general no-public-drinking period and separate, more restrictive periods for designated zones.
Singapore public places; special schedules in designated liquor control zones
Singapore Attorney-General's Chambers, Singapore Statutes Online
Check current hours, zone boundaries, public event exceptions and distinction from shop sales.
The National Environment Agency lists indoor and outdoor places subject to smoking prohibition, and identifies a distinct Orchard Road zone with designated smoking areas.
Singapore tobacco smoking rules; national prohibited places and local zone
Verify venue rules and designated areas. Vaping and alcohol are separate legal topics.
New Zealand's Department of Conservation provides a recreational drone permission process for public conservation land and waters.
New Zealand public conservation land and waters only
Check the site, airspace, permit limitations and separate CAA obligations.
Certain activities on New Zealand public conservation land and waters, including recreational drone operation, have a Department of Conservation permission process.
Public conservation land and waters; activity-specific
Check the site's opening, activity, permit terms and any additional access controls.
Australia instructs travelers to declare biosecurity risk items including certain food and plant or animal products and used equipment from rural areas or near animals.
Australian Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry
Check the item, packaging, origin, and the permitted import conditions in BICON. Declaration is not guaranteed permission.
Australia's traveler guidance describes declaration of biosecurity risk goods during the arrival process.
Australian Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry
Check the form or digital trial for the specific route and carrier, and immigration or money declarations separately.
